Inside the instrument ＋

Ultrasonic distance is smoothed into eight zones. Motion and mode determine rhythm, bass and melody. One layer is replaced for eight steps, then returns to PLAY.

The control board handles sensing, the 30-LED loop and time-sliced audio. Serial messages go to a second board, which scrolls text on the 8×8 matrix.

  • Ultrasonic sensor
  • LED matrix
  • NeoPixel loop
  • Seven buttons
  • Audio output
  • Control board
  • Display board
